- **Repair damaged photos:** older JPEGs that won't open can now be repaired. In the photo viewer, choose More › Jobs › Repair photo…, or use Library Care › Damaged media. You see the damaged photo beside the repaired one, and nothing changes until you choose Replace with repaired photo. The damaged original is kept.
- **Steadier background work:** busy servers no longer drop job updates, so finished work doesn't run again. Long videos no longer fail while their details are read.
- **Clearer waiting counts:** on the Jobs page, Reading photo details shows the photos still to read, with the photos finishing up counted separately beneath it, so the count no longer looks stuck.
- **More jobs at once:** each task can now run up to 32 jobs at once. If a task is set higher than Jobs at once allows, Frameleaf says so and offers to raise it.
- **More reliable phone backup:** a backup that switches between fast multi-part uploads and one-piece uploads mid-file now finishes instead of failing.
